Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: production 2D animation sprite sheet for an existing Windows desktop companion.
Reference image: the attached/local main-look.png is the exact identity and art style to preserve: cute full-body chibi white dragon girl, large white hair, lavender eyes, two white curved horns, white flower knot hair ornament on viewer's right, pointed ears, tiny lavender bat wings, white curved dragon tail, simple white lavender dress and shoes, soft clean dark-lavender outline. Preserve the same character and body proportions in every frame. This is an animation atlas, not a presentation page.
Generate ONE transparent RGBA portrait sprite sheet, ideally 1024 by 1536 pixels, exactly FOUR equal columns and SIX equal rows (24 distinct frames). The entire canvas is the 4x6 grid: no title, no labels, no borders, no lines, no text, no watermark, no background, no cast ground shadows. Each cell is square. Every frame shows the complete character, same fixed scale, head anchor and foot baseline aligned; keep 8% empty transparent margin within each cell so ears, horns, wings and tail cannot cross cell boundaries. Character height about 82% of each square cell. A row is a smooth four-frame LOOP of a single action; each neighboring frame must visibly change and the fourth must loop naturally to the first. No unrelated props.
Row 1, top: GETTING HEAD STROKED. Girl closes her eyes in delight, cheeks rosy, head tilts gently left / center / right / center, shoulders relax, bangs and tail subtly follow. No human hand, no floating symbols.
Row 2: EATING A LITTLE TREAT. Girl holds one small plain golden round cookie in both hands at chest height. Frame 1 lifts cookie with a small open mouth; frame 2 bites; frame 3 cheeks puff as she chews, eyes happy closed; frame 4 swallows and smiles, hands lower slightly. Consistent cookie prop, no extra limbs.
Row 3: VERY HAPPY MOOD. Bright smiling eyes and mouth; hands clasp happily at chest, small gentle bounce (no more than 4% vertical change), happy swishing tail. Four distinct beat poses, returning to first.
Row 4: ANGRY / TEASED. Cute pout, eyes half narrowed, arms crossed, face turns subtly left / center / right / center, tail flicks; no tears.
Row 5: BORED WITH REPEATED FOOD. Half-lidded unimpressed lavender eyes, flat small mouth, head on one hand, tiny sigh and side glance, subtle head and tail motion. Keep standing full body and the same baseline.
Row 6, bottom: ASLEEP. BOTH EYES FULLY CLOSED in every frame, peaceful relaxed mouth, cheek resting on clasped hands, tiny rhythmic breathing visible in shoulders, slightly drooping tail and wings. Four subtly different breathing phases. No 'Z', no text.
Prioritize exact grid placement, consistent character identity and clean readable expressions over costume detail. Use real transparent alpha for all empty pixels.
